own.notes: Domain: integer quantities q=1..1000. Select the last segment whose from<=q; evaluate constant + linear*q + quadratic*q^2, round to integer pence and clamp to nonnegative. The bands are 1..146, 147..731 and 732..1000. Reconstructed from exact REA captures after application inspection. Direct probes confirmed the marginal-rate changes across 146/147 and 731/732, including adjacent quantities. All 96 distinct observed quantities matched exactly: 16 exploratory samples, 16 transition/local probes and 64 subsequent validation samples spread across the domain. The model was fixed before those 64 validation samples; their exact-match, within-1% and within-5% rates were each 100%, with maximum absolute error 0 pence. High confidence in this three-band affine predictor, but 904 quantities remain unobserved. Validation does not prove exactness everywhere or exclude narrow unsampled exceptions.
